dpw_reanchor.method: fa_signings_implied trailing mean; tier shape preserved

notes: veterans: the FA module's Gate-1-validated Marcel engine; bands = Gate-1 empirical year-1 residual quantiles decayed along the fitted aging curves
prospects: P(bucket|FV) x calibrated per-bucket WAR trajectories from projected debut age, starting at the PROSPX ETA; floor/ceiling = 10th/90th-percentile OUTCOME buckets
dollars: convex tier pricing at the 2027 ex-ante FA $/WAR level, escalated per season; veteran surplus only on salary-known (contracted) seasons, discounted at the platform rate
two-way players project BOTH sides, summed per season (per-side paths in warHit/warPit; bands combine at assumed cross-side correlation rho=0.5 - documented)
veteran universe: >= 100 PA or >= 30 IP in one of the last three seasons
